messages:
IncidentBot: [PAGER] HIGH - canary deploy (deploy-2026-05) in us-west-2 is emitting a spike of 5xx for /v1/generate. Canary shares ~4% of traffic. Paging alex.nguyen. link: https://mon.redwood/in/alerts/3742504321
alex.nguyen: on it. seeing 503s from model-proxy pods in canary -> connection reset by peer patterns in logs. pulling logs now.
priya.kumar: @alex any customer-facing impact yet?
alex.nguyen: frontend shows 5xx rate ~6% for that route, error budget for tier-1 might be affected. sending initial note to status page.
jamie.lee: which canary variant? quant-kernel v2 or v1?
alex.nguyen: quant-kernel-v2 (cpu fallback path enabled). deploy-bot shows rollout started 4m ago.
deploy-bot: deploy-2026-05 canary: replicas=6 -> 2 in canary; images: runtime:1.4.2, kernel:quant-v2.
maria.garcia: I can take logs + metrics pairing. forwarding histogram of latencies.
alex.nguyen: quick test: 
```
curl -sS -D - https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED' -d '{"prompt":"test"}' -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n"
```
returns 503 intermittently from canary LB.
priya.kumar: ok sounds like a bad kernel path. Recommend kill-switch the feature flag that enabled quant-kernel-v2 for canary and rollback canary. Who can flip fflag?
jamie.lee: I can flip it. fflag key: experiments.model-serving.quant-kernel-v2.canary.
jamie.lee: flipping now -> setting to false :spinner:
deploy-bot: feature flag experiments.model-serving.quant-kernel-v2.canary set to false (actor=jamie.lee)
alex.nguyen: waiting for flag to propagate to canary nodes. watching metrics.
maria.garcia: after flag flip, 5xx dropped to 1.2% within 30s. still some tail errors (0.3%).
priya.kumar: good. customer impact: small subset of requests (canary traffic only) affected; no broad outage. advised status page note updated: "intermittent 503s for a small % of traffic in us-west-2 during canary rollout; mitigated by disabling quant-kernel-v2 in canary"
oncall-lead: prepare handoff to next oncall for follow-up (postmortem + rollback). next oncall is maria.garcia. handoff at 3742504600.
alex.nguyen: plan: 1) rollback canary (kubectl rollout undo on canary deployment), 2) run healthcheck sweep, 3) re-run canary with additional observability and lower traffic. doing step1 now.
jamie.lee: kubectl command I ran for rollback: 
```
kubectl -n model-system rollout undo deploy/model-proxy --to-revision=348
```
alex.nguyen: rollback executed. pods restarting.
maria.garcia: running synthetic sweep: 
- /v1/generate sampling 1000 requests -> 2xx rate 99.9%
- p95 latency steady.
priya.kumar: any customers escalated or support tickets opened?
alex.nguyen: no direct support tickets yet, small number of errors surfaced in telemetry but not tied to paying enterprise requests. flagged for follow-up.
maria.garcia: will own follow-up: check kernel abort traces, kernel swap instrumentation, and add canary gating for kernel until we validate.
oncall-lead: handoff: incident mitigated, root cause suspected integration of quant-kernel-v2 with new memory pool allocator. next steps: full postmortem, test harness reproducer, stricter canary rollout policy (gradual ramp, auto-kill at 1% errors). @maria.garcia you own.
maria.garcia: ack. I'll write incident summary + timeline and schedule RCA.
alex.nguyen: leaving the channel, tagging @maria.garcia as owner. :thumbsup:
priya.kumar: thanks team. closing pager.
IncidentBot: Pager closed by alex.nguyen at 3742504667.
